title: How Pump-and-Dump Groups Work
summary: A pump-and-dump group coordinates to buy a small, low-volume coin at once, creating a sudden spike that draws in outsiders — who become the exit liquidity.
blocks: A pump-and-dump group coordinates to buy a small, low-volume coin at once, creating a sudden spike that draws in outsiders — who become the exit liquidity.
Organisers and early members sell into that spike, and the price collapses. The people who joined on the excitement are usually the ones left holding losses.
Signals to be wary of: chat groups promising a synchronised move, sudden hype around an obscure coin, and countdowns telling everyone to act at the same moment.
